Introduction
Heading: Five decades of getting difficult projects built.

Konsadem Associates Limited is one of Nigeria's leading indigenous engineering consultancies. We began in Ibadan in 1972 and have spent every year since on the work that keeps cities and farms running: water supply, sanitation, dams, irrigation, roads, drainage, structures and waste management.

Our engineers have assessed Lagos's water distribution network, designed sewerage for whole university campuses, supervised irrigation schemes for the Federal Government and channelised the Ogunpa River through the heart of Ibadan. We bring the same discipline to a private estate as to a World Bank programme.

Roads, drainage and erosion control. Highways, bridges, drainage channels and flood works that stand up to Nigerian conditions.

about: Page header
Headline: Built in Ibadan. Trusted across Nigeria.
Sub-headline: An indigenous engineering consultancy with five decades of practice and a record of delivery for governments, development banks and private clients.
Who we are

Konsadem Associates Limited (RC 106297) is a multidisciplinary firm of engineers and consultants. We take projects from first study to final handover: feasibility, design, procurement, construction supervision, maintenance and management.

Our team is about 70 strong, and some 50 of us are professional and technical staff. Several of our engineers reached senior management in the public sector before moving into consultancy, so we understand how clients work from the inside.
When a project calls for it, we bring in specialist consultants in economics and finance, geology, sociology, demography and statistics.
Our story
Heading: From a three-person practice to a national firm.
1972. Adeyemi, Ogundipe & Partners is established to offer civil and structural engineering consultancy, with Engr. B. O. Adeyemi as its most senior partner.
1985. After a restructuring, the Ibadan practice becomes an independent firm under a new name: Konsadem Associates Limited.
1989 onwards. Konsadem designs and supervises road projects for the Oyo and Osun State Governments and the World Bank's Multi-State Roads Project.
2002 to 2004. We redesign and supervise the 3.5 km Middle Ogunpa River channelisation in Ibadan, including eight bridges.
2011. Konsadem forms a consortium with SCS Engineers (USA) and ENTAG (Egypt) on the Lagos Integrated Waste Management Project.
2016 to 2023. We provide project management support to the AFD-funded Ogun Urban Water Supply Project, in consortium with SAFEGE of Belgium.
Today. From offices in Ibadan, Abuja, Lagos and Kigali, we are at work on water, irrigation and sanitation projects for the Federal Government, state governments and private clients.
Mission
To be the best indigenous engineering and consultancy organisation in Nigeria, delivering professional services that are timely, economical and kind to the environment.
Vision (draft for approval)
Infrastructure across Africa that is resilient to a changing climate, serves its communities for generations, and is designed and delivered by African engineers.
Our values
Heading: Nine commitments behind every drawing we sign.
Innovation. We use modern modelling and design tools to find better answers, not just familiar ones.
Quality. Our work is checked, documented and built to last.
Safety. People come first, on site and in the communities around it.
Integrity. We give clients the honest answer, including when it is not the easy one.
Collaboration. We work as one team with clients, contractors and international partners.
Client focus. Your objectives set our priorities.
Continuous improvement. Every project teaches us something we carry into the next.
Sustainability. We design for climate resilience and long service life.
Accountability. We own our deliverables, our deadlines and our results.
Leadership
Heading: Led by engineers who have done the work.
Engr. B. O. Adeyemi, Chairman. B.Sc, Dip. Sanitary Engineering, FICE, FNSE, MACEN, COREN. Founding senior partner of the practice in 1972 and Chairman of the Board.

Engr. Adesoji Adeyemi, Managing Director and CEO. A civil engineering graduate of the University of Lagos (1989) with a Master's in Water Resources Engineering from Loughborough University, UK (1996). Over 30 years in consultancy, construction supervision, water resources, dams, irrigation, highways and WASH. He has led projects with the World Bank, EU, AfDB, AFD, USAID and DFID, and served as Institutional and Policy Expert on the EU's Niger Delta Support Programme.

Engr. Sesan Adeyemo, Director. Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Civil Engineering from the University of Ibadan and an Executive Master's in Project Management from the Project Management College, UK. Over 20 years across water supply, sanitation, structures, procurement, contract management and supervision.

Engr. Abdulazeez Olanrewaju, Director. A civil engineering graduate of Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria, with a Master's from the University of Ibadan. Over 18 years in water resources, water supply and sanitation, including the Wigwe University sewer network and WASH design across Borno, Adamawa and Yobe States.
Tools and technology

Our engineers work with AutoCAD, CivilCAD and WaterCAD for design, and with HEC-HMS, SWAT, MIKE HYDRO and WEAP for hydrological and climate modelling. In the field we use GPS, total stations and a down-the-hole CCTV camera for borehole inspection.

services.title: Water supply and sanitation
services.tagline: Clean water in. Wastewater safely out.
body: Water is where our reputation was built. We study, design and supervise water supply schemes, treatment plants, transmission mains and distribution networks, along with sewerage and sewage treatment for campuses, estates, hospitals and towns.

What we deliver: water resources studies, treatment plant and distribution design, reticulation, water-retaining structures, sewerage and sewage treatment, storm water disposal, master drainage planning, borehole drilling and installation, and customer enumeration and network assessment for utilities.

Proof: For Lagos Water Corporation we are mapping and modelling the Iju, Adiyan and Ishasi distribution networks. In Rivers State we carried out the studies and design for rehabilitating 18 water schemes serving Port Harcourt and Obio-Akpor.

services.title: Dams, irrigation and hydropower
body: We plan and design the structures that store water, move it and turn it into food and power. Our work spans hydrological and geophysical investigation, dam and reservoir design, canals and pipelines, inter-basin transfers and small hydropower.

What we deliver: dam and impounding reservoir design, irrigation and land drainage, hydraulic structures, land capability and agronomic studies, agricultural economic studies, and small and medium hydropower design.
Proof: Redesign and supervision of the Middle and Lower Ogun Irrigation Projects, the Hawal Inter-Basin Water Transfer study, and hydropower designs at Ogbesse and Ogwashi-Uku dams.

services.title: Roads, bridges and drainage
body: We design and supervise rural, municipal and trunk roads, bridges in steel and concrete, and the drainage and erosion control works that protect them.
What we deliver: economic feasibility studies, condition surveys and traffic studies, highway and bridge design, flood control, river channelisation, erosion control and land reclamation.
Proof: The 3.5 km Middle Ogunpa River channelisation in Ibadan with eight bridges, the Osogbo–Ikirun road dualisation, and the Ogba–Ijaye drainage channel in Ikeja for LAMATA.

services.title: Structural and building engineering
body: We design buildings and industrial structures in reinforced concrete, prestressed concrete, steel, timber and composite construction, and we stay on site to see them built correctly.

What we deliver: multi-storey buildings, schools, laboratories, hostels, factories, silos, machine foundations, geotechnical and foundation engineering, architectural design, and turnkey industrial planning.

Proof: Classroom blocks for the University of Uyo, a workshop, diagnostic centre and hostel for the College of Technology, Esa-Oke, and treatment plant structures for Wigwe University and Afe Babalola University.

services.title: Environment and solid waste
body: We help governments and operators understand their waste, plan for it and build the facilities to handle it. We also carry out the environmental and social studies that funders require.

What we deliver: waste characterisation studies, waste management master plans, landfill and transfer station design, recycling facility design, landfill gas capture, environmental and social impact assessment, and climate adaptation and disaster preparedness planning.

Proof: The Lagos Integrated Waste Management Project for LAWMA, a 286-sample waste characterisation study across four Lagos dump sites, and a materials recycling facility design in Owerri for the Federal Ministry of Environment.

services.title: Mechanical and electrical works
services.tagline: The systems that make infrastructure run.
body: We design and manage the mechanical and electrical side of infrastructure projects, from pumping stations to power supply.
What we deliver: design and installation supervision for power plants, pumps and switchgear, air-conditioning and refrigeration, electromechanical works, and power generation and distribution.

services.title: Project management and supervision
services.tagline: On time, on budget, on specification.
body: Clients and funders appoint us to protect their investment. We plan, procure, supervise and report, so that what was designed is what gets built.

What we deliver: project planning and initiation, tender documents and bills of engineering measurement, procurement and contract management, construction supervision, financial control, and monitoring and evaluation.
Proof: Seven years of project management support to the AFD-funded Ogun Urban Water Supply Project.

services.title: Studies, policy and institutional development
services.tagline: Good infrastructure starts with good decisions.
body: We advise governments and utilities on the questions that come before, and after, construction.

What we deliver: feasibility and viability studies, project economic evaluation, water policy formulation, tariff methodology, institutional assessment and reform, asset management and privatisation of public utilities, PPP structuring, capacity building and training.
Proof: Development of the Edo State Water, Sanitation and Hygiene Policy under the EU's Niger Delta Support Programme, and a review of the Lagos State WASH policy.

services.title: Digital engineering and training
body: We apply computer-aided design, GIS and hydraulic modelling to our own projects, and we develop software applications and training for clients who want the same capability in-house.

why: Page header
Headline: The firm other firms partner with.
Sub-headline: Six reasons clients and international consultancies keep coming back.
Six reasons
1. Five decades of continuity. Our practice began in 1972. Few Nigerian consultancies can show a record that long, or the institutional memory that comes with it.

2. Trusted by the funders that scrutinise hardest. We have delivered on projects financed by the World Bank, the European Union, AFD, AfDB, USAID and DFID. We know their procurement rules, safeguards and reporting standards.
3. International partners, local command. Haskoning, Nihon Suido, SAFEGE, Reid Crowther, SCS Engineers and ENTAG have all worked with us. They bring global methods; we bring the ground truth.
4. One team for the whole project. Studies, design, procurement, supervision and institutional support sit in one firm. Nothing is lost in handover between consultants.
5. Built for a changing climate. Climate adaptation, environmental and social risk management, water security analysis and disaster preparedness are part of our core service, not an add-on.

6. Engineers who answer for their work. Our directors are COREN-registered and sit in the Nigerian Society of Engineers. Formal project management and quality assurance processes stand behind every deliverable.
Who we work for
Heading: Clients who expect a lot.

Federal Government. Federal Ministry of Water Resources, Federal Ministry of Power, Federal Ministry of Environment, Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, Federal Capital Development Authority, FCT Water Board, Nigeria Sovereign Investment Authority, Ecological Fund Office.
State governments and agencies. Lagos Water Corporation, LAWMA, LAMATA, and the governments of Edo, Ekiti, Ogun, Osun, Oyo, Ondo and Rivers States.
River basin authorities. Ogun-Osun and Benin-Owena River Basin Development Authorities.
Development partners and NGOs. World Bank, European Union, AFD, AfDB, USAID, DFID, UNHCR, Mercy Corps.
Universities. University of Ibadan, University of Uyo, Wigwe University, Afe Babalola University, Landmark University, LAUTECH Teaching Hospital, Federal University of Petroleum Resources.
Private sector. Segilola Gold Project, Victoria Garden City residents' association, CPCS Transcom, and private estate developers.
